blocks.body:
## Classification results

Tests of logistic regression and random forestAUCBoth are approximately0.994, The gradient lift is approximately0.992, The decision tree is approximately0.972. The first three models have highly overlapping intervals, Thousandth differences are insufficient to form a stable ranking. Threshold selection0.5time, The decision treeBalanced Accuracyand malignant recall has the highest, gradient boosting'sF1andBrierBetter.

## Reading the boundaries

- Malignant uniform coding is1, AllRecallandFNAll explained according to this 1 caliber. 
- Feature filtering uses only455Example training sample, 114For example, the test sample is only used for final evaluation. 
- highAUCfrom the current data structure andX, YThe more direct morphological link, Does not represent that the algorithm is equally effective on other data. 
- This is an internal test on teaching data, No external hospital, Validation on different devices or different populations. 
- Coefficient and tree model importance explain model dependency., does not indicate medical cause and effect, Nor can it be used for clinical diagnosis..
